'''ME-D1''', pronounced '''Meedee-one''', was a [[ME-D]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] built by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It, alongside the other Meedees, was taught Jedi history and philosophy by Leeha in hopes of proving that even droids could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
